podcast.body: The 2005 album "In Your Honor" was considered for the alternative title "Foo Are You." During its recording at the newly established 606 Studios, the facility was not yet fully complete, requiring all band members to actively participate in construction tasks like stuffing insulation to prepare the studio for use. "Here's a track recorded for the In Your Honor album, which by the way was almost called Fuhar U. The studio wasn't quite finished when they moved in. So everybody had to help out with things like stuffing and insulation."
